taxonomic_note: Accepted by Kew and GRIN; Texas is within the native range at the state level, but the project has not locked three exact target-zone counties.
look_here_first: Treat this as the tall biennial evening-primrose comparison: a first-year basal rosette followed by an erect flowering stem with yellow 4-petaled evening-opening flowers and elongate capsules.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Kew and GRIN support Texas nativity, but the latest project review did not recover three explicit project target-zone counties. BONAP county mapping remains a reference rather than a completed three-county lock.

approval_exception.reason: Learner admission is independent from native-range certification. Preserve the scientific HOLD rather than inventing county evidence.

morphology_keys.comparison_training: Much taller and more erect than low O. laciniata or spreading O. capillifolia; identification and local-range certification are separate questions.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Use life cycle, tall erect habit, rosette, yellow evening-opening flowers, and elongate capsules together.
